text:
samir.k: quick heads-up — vendor (AeroFreight) just pushed H100 lead times from ~6w to ~9w. allocation for Q2 looks ~30% lower if we accept. decision needed: accept later ETA or pay to expedite?

maria.ops: ouch. do we have runway on active rollouts?

ops-bot: inventory update: prod-pool H100s=18, staging=6, loaner=2

jia-ml: 18 prod units won't cover the next 3 projected spikes. can we mix H100/H200s for some workloads temporarily?

ben-proc: pinging AeroFreight now. asking for expedited air options + cost delta and any concession for the lead-time change

linda-aero: hi all — confirmed on our side. factory re-prioritized a tier-1 partner so your slot moved. we can offer air uplift (partial split) but freight ~3x sea and customs timelines still apply.

samir.k: two asks: 1) what's the expedite landed cost ±duties; 2) what’s the RMA/DOA handling risk if we switch to more air (damage incidence + pickup flow)? also EU customs are requiring serial-escrow manifests more strictly now.

alex-logistics: for air we need same-day pre-alerts and a consolidated AWB manifest. RMA flow unchanged: 30-day DOA window, vendor prepay return labels via forwarder network. if customs flags serials we need depot preflight to reconcile before release.

maria.ops: can procurement get any credit for the 3w slip? need a concession — financial or operational (expedite on next batch).

ben-proc: asked vendor for either a 5% partial credit OR free expedite on a subsequent container. asked for confirmation by EOD.

linda-aero: vendor can offer 3% credit OR one free full-expedite on a following shipment (subject to their capacity calendar). need selection from you.

jia-ml: long-term, the free expedite on the next shipment is worth more to product SLAs than 3% credit. recommend expedite.

samir.k: agree — expedite on next shipment > small credit. but we must lock down RMA pairing and customs steps so expedite doesn't create more friction.

alex-logistics: proposed split + RMA steps:
- Split ship: top 10 units by priority -> air, remainder -> sea
- Depot preflight on arrival: serial reconciliation against manifest to avoid EU hold
- DOA flow: forwarder collects with prepaid return label, depot swaps and issues replacement from pooled units

Sample manifest snippet (for pre-alert):
```
AWB: 123-45678901
Carrier: AeroAir
Priority units: H100-ABCD1234,H100-ABCD1235,...,H100-ABCD1243
Consol ref: AF-Q2-789
```

ben-proc: vendor set cutoff for air booking by unix ts 1746700000 — need signoff by tomorrow EOD to lock space.

maria.ops: what's rough cost delta if we do 10 units air vs sea?

linda-aero: ballpark landed: air uplift =~+$12k/unit to EU, +$9k/unit to US. sea per-unit landed =~+$2k (port+overland). exact once origin flight/route priced.

jia-ml: can we use loaner pool for critical infra until arrivals to avoid paying air for all?

ops-bot: loaner pool remaining=2 (current).

samir.k: not enough loaners for the scale we need. action items: 
- ben-proc: confirm vendor concession (expedite on next shipment) and send PO amendment — due EOD
- alex-logistics: draft split-shipment manifest + RMA return-label workflow + depot preflight checklist — due +24h
- maria.ops: model cost delta vs potential revenue/ops impact and recommend pay/accept threshold — due +48h

ben-proc: on it. pinging @linda-aero for immediate confirmation in-thread.

linda-aero: confirming in-thread: vendor accepts the expedite concession (one full expedite on next shipment) if we sign a PO amendment. sending amendment draft to procurement now.

samir.k: once amendment lands, legal & finance to fast-track sign-off. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
